newsitem.title: CROATIA: SOCCER-CROATIA WITHOUT INJURED STANIC AND STIMAC AGAINST BOSNIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CROATIA WITHOUT INJURED STANIC AND STIMAC AGAINST BOSNIA.

text.p: Croatia will be without Mario Stanic and Igor Stimac because of injury for their opening World Cup qualifier against neighbouring Bosnia on Tuesday.
Defender Stimac is expected to be replaced by Zvonimir Soldo while either Dario Simic or the more attacking Nikola Jurcevic are likely to take Stanic's place in midfield.
Press reports said central defender Nikola Jerkan and midfielder Robert Jarni also had minor injury problems but were expected to play.

Croatia, who reached the quarter-finals in this year's European Championship, are strongly fancied to win through to the World Cup finals from a group which also includes Denmark, Slovenia and Greece.
The match against Bosnia will be played on neutral territory in Bologna, Italy, after a FIFA ruling that Sarajevo's Kosevo stadium, severely damaged during the war, was not up to standard.
Goalkeeper - Drazen Ladic, Nikola Jerkan, Slaven Bilic, Zvonimir Soldo, Dario Simic (Nikola Jurcevic), Robert Jarni, Zvonimir Boban, Robert Prosinecki, Aljosa Asanovic, Davor Suker, Alen Boksic.
